title: A conversation brought back by a reminder says Reminder returned (real Gmail)
steps: With a real Gmail test account, open a low-stakes Inbox conversation, set Remind me… two minutes ahead, then press E
Wait until it comes back to the top of the Inbox; look at the row, the line under the subject in the reader and a search for its subject
With VoiceOver on, move to the row
Press E on it, then Cmd-Z
expected: A grey chip reading exactly Reminder returned (not lowercase) leads the row and the search result; the reader line shows ● Reminder returned; VoiceOver says Reminder returned. Reading or starring keeps it. After E it is gone, and Cmd-Z brings the conversation back without it.
